svg.text: ONE ORTHONORMAL HAAR LEVEL OF THE PATCH: FOUR 3 × 3 SUBBANDS FROM THE 6 × 6 PADDED PATCH
dashed: the mirrored row and column
block p q over r s: LL = (p+q+r+s)/2 · HL = (p−q+r−s)/2
orange: the impulse, one coefficient per subband
blue dashed: the step, three −160s in HL
LL is shaded 0 to 510; details print their sign
